BL-878 — DEFECT — nine handoffd wiring tests spawn their daemon through `setsid`, which stock macOS does not ship; the daemon never starts and each test dies as a wait-loop timeout rather than a named error
What it solves: - `$!` subtlety, for the implementer and the reviewer: with `setsid cmd &`,
  `$!` is the pid of `setsid` itself, which may or may not be the pid of the
  daemon depending on whether setsid forks (it execs directly when it is not
  already a process-group leader). With `nohup cmd &` it is the daemo…
Approval context: New feature draft needs review. No scope fork to decide here: the fix shape is already settled by BL-802 (production, `start_babysitterd.sh`) and by one sibling test in this very suite that already does it correctly (`test_handoffd_role_context_clear_skip_rotation_router.sh:65`), so this is the nin…
BL-878 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-878" (or "reject BL-878 <reason>") to act.
